claim_boundary: fresh one-pass prefix-to-full address adaptation with factual tie-break verification; no general continual-learning claim

controls.fresh_address_evidence: post-promotion lifetimes; no promotion holdout replay
controls.address_isolation: candidate route index changed while factual model digest remained byte-identical
controls.ambiguity_refusal: address proposal may resolve only a close factual tie and cannot override a decisive factual winner
controls.learning_rate: 0.003 and 0.03 produced the same rejected gate outcome

interpretation: The versioned copy-on-write address seam is mechanically sound and persistence-tested, but one fresh prefix-alignment update did not improve the long-horizon partial-routing gate. The bottleneck is not merely optimizer step size; partial evidence can still be assigned a decisive but incorrect factual identity, while safe address gating correctly refuses to override it. Retain the interface and controls, but do not claim a learned continual-memory routing gain until an evidence-efficient identity mechanism passes the unchanged factual, retention, and ambiguity gates.
